scientific.integrity: The primary open PDF was inspected at the stochastic model, jump assumptions, logarithmic transformation, quasi-endemic linearization, Theorem 5.1, and its Fokker–Planck derivation. The counterexample satisfies the source assumptions and the theorem threshold. The analytic contradiction uses the fourth cumulant of the stationary Lévy stochastic convolution; numerical quadrature is only a reproducibility check. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result corrects the exact Gaussian/log-normal density statement for the linearized logarithmic jump process. It does not classify the full nonlinear stationary distribution or rule out a separately justified Gaussian diffusion approximation. The Brownian-only boundary case remains Gaussian.

title: Lévy jumps invalidate the Gaussian density theorem for the linearized stochastic SVI model
